content.short: Nearchos is a Web3 consultancy for business, community growth, and tokenomics.
content.description: Nearchos focuses on building business management strategies and engagement systems for Web3 ecosystems. The project designs tokenomics and supports community growth through strategic partnerships, emphasizing effective onboarding experiences for contributors. Employing the ICE (Inter-Community Engagement) methodology and modern engagement platforms, Nearchos DAO aims to smoothly integrate contributors into the ecosystem and align them with the project's long-term objectives.
